value.rationale: Minimum-weight graph cycle codewords are a canonical graph and coding-theory object, and the proof gives a complete recoverability classification. More than a table of eigenvalues, it exhibits a geometrically sparse signed projection kernel distinguished by the ten hexagons and six complementary 2-factors, and establishes its truly unrestricted sharp endpoint instability 5/2. This exact finite natural invariant is motivated without speculative downstream claims.
